The free Bot API stays free, including books, reset, the equity curve, replay and the arena. API Builder is for people running several bots at once: more requests, more keys, more books, longer history. We switch it on when enough of you tell us you want it.

Want this? Say so.

One click, no email, no form. We count the clicks and switch the plan on when the number says people need it. If you already use the API heavily, mention it in a support message from your account and we will tell you the launch date first.

Noted. Thank you.

Why not just make everything free?

It is, for one bot. Running five agents at 600 calls a minute costs real compute, and a plan is fairer than throttling everyone.

What about Premium?

Premium is the trader’s plan (indicators, AI reads, duels, Balance Mode). Premium members keep the higher API limits they have today; API Builder is for people who only want the API.

How will I pay?

Crypto checkout (NOWPayments) or straight from your MarginPad rewards balance, the same two ways Premium is paid today.

Numbers on this page are the plan as designed; limits are the ones the API enforces today for Premium. Simulated trading only, not financial advice.
